Title: Using Troglodytia's special ability on a card (the same player) already Suddened

Messages.Author: Lönkka
Messages.Body:
Can Troglodytia still use her ability after the very same player has Suddened the master card she wants to use her speeciality on?

Player A: I play Villein.
Player B: I play Sudden Reversal on Villein.
Player B: I use Troglodytia's special ability on the Villein.

Should you actually use her specialty BEFORE playing the Sudden Reversal?

I figured that since Sudden was played (by the same player no less), the window for Troglodytia's special ability had already gone.

Troglodytia
Independent: After any Methuselah plays a master card, you may look at that Methuselah's hand (after the replacement card is drawn). +1 strength.

Sudden Reversal
Cancel a master card played by another Methuselah as it is played (no cost is paid).

Finnish  Politics!

Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body: Isn't both on the same windows, I.E. as the card is played ?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Troglodytia's special occurs "after" the card is played, which is after "as it is played".
"as it is played" occurs even before the card is replaced, so there's no doubt here.

A plays Villein (not replaced)
B plays Sudden Reversal (not replaced)
B replaces SR
A replaces Villein
B use Troglodyta's special.

Name: Blessing of the Beast
Cardtype: Master
Clan: Ahrimane
Burn Option
Master.
Put this card on an Ahrimane with any number of cards that require Spiritus [spi] from your hand (face down). You may look at these cards at any time. This Ahrimane may play these cards as if from your hand. Burn this card when it has no more of these cards on it. A vampire may have only one Blessing of the Beast.

Cards you place on Blessing of the Beast are chosen when the card is played, as its terms. At this moment, you haven't replaced the Blessing of the Beast card (we're a tad before the cancelling-as-played window).

EDIT: I didn't get the question right
Re-Edit:
I can't find a precedent ruling for this.
So we'll go with what already exists, and that would be cardtext (in our case, Permanency).
"After X is played" is after resolution of X.

Regarding Blessing of the Beast vs Troglodytia: You look at the hand after the Spiritus cards were placed on the Blessing of the Beast, and after they were replaced.
